scientific_integrity: Analytical proof provided. Exact rational finite tests are corroboration only, not infinite certification. General-purpose finite-metric LP methods are established prior work.
scientific_limitations: Finite connected simple unweighted graphs with real scalars; arbitrary weighted metric graph edges not claimed.
General graph grid optimization need not be polynomial-time; path recursion uses cubic arithmetic operations.
Earlier equivalent results under unindexed terminology and independent mathematical evaluation remain possible.
title: Sharp discrete slope spectrum and grid formula for Dudley norms on finite graph metrics
